test_title: PYST 24: SSC JE EE- General Awareness (Held on: 22 March 2021 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: As of January 2021, how much premium is payable for the annual commercial/horticulture crops under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana, as a percentage of the sum insured/actuarial rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5%**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **The Payable Annual Commercial / Annual Horticultural crops under Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana is 5% of SI or Actuarial rate, whichever is less.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) launched on 18th February 2016. **
 
• It **aims** at supporting sustainable production in the agriculture sector by
 
 
• Providing **financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of unforeseen events.**
 
• **Stabilizing the income of farmers to ensure their continuance in farming**
 
• Encouraging farmers to adopt innovative and modern agricultural practices
 
• Ensuring the flow of credit to the agriculture sector.
 
 
 
• **Payment**__:
 
 
• 
 **Kharif All foodgrain and Oilseeds crops: **2.0% of SI or Actuarial rate, whichever is less.
 
 
• 
 **Rabi All foodgrain and Oilseeds crops:** 1.5% of SI or Actuarial rate, whichever is less.
